caches.sourceOfTruth: SwiftData models queried by the home screen container and shaped by snapshot builders.
caches.invalidation: Pet/human/reminder/care ledger/family task revision changes invalidate only affected home snapshots.
caches.expiry: Route-scoped; refresh when visible, after explicit command completion, or when revision tokens change.
caches.recovery: Render empty or placeholder snapshots, then refresh after the first frame.

caches.sourceOfTruth: Human and pet avatar image data plus cached preview PNG files derived from those payload signatures.
caches.invalidation: Avatar payload signature changes, explicit nil payloads, LRU capacity eviction (24 entries normally, 8 under low-power/reduced-work policy), and UIApplication memory warnings invalidate decoded UIImage entries; bounded in-flight decodes are generation-checked so stale work cannot repopulate an eviction.
caches.expiry: Decoded entries are an LRU working set only; preview files remain a lazy fallback cache data source.
caches.recovery: Render placeholders or preview entries, then rebuild only a bounded deferred batch through AvatarPipeline / FocusWalletAvatarCache after the first frame.

caches.sourceOfTruth: Card popout image data keyed by payload signature.
caches.invalidation: Popout payload signature changes, explicit nil or empty payloads, LRU capacity eviction (16 entries normally, 6 under low-power/reduced-work policy), and UIApplication memory warnings invalidate decoded UIImage entries; generation checks prevent stale in-flight decodes from restoring evicted entries.
caches.expiry: Decoded memory entries are a bounded LRU working set, not a gallery-wide cache.
caches.recovery: Render without the popout image until route-scoped bounded preload rebuilds it through the detached decode path.

caches.sourceOfTruth: User-imported media bytes resolved by visible routes and keyed by a stable item id, source payload signature, and requested max pixel size.
caches.invalidation: Source payload signature changes create a new thumbnail key; LRU capacity eviction (48 entries normally, 16 under low-power/reduced-work policy) and UIApplication memory warnings cancel in-flight decode tasks and clear decoded UIImage and transparency-flag entries through MemoryWarningEvictionRegistry.
caches.expiry: Decoded thumbnail and transparency entries are a bounded visible-media working set; routes recover by showing placeholders and lazily requesting thumbnails for visible media.
caches.recovery: Render lightweight placeholders, then rebuild downsampled thumbnails and derived transparency flags through a cancellable, budgeted MediaThumbnailProvider task when tiles appear.

caches.sourceOfTruth: Food, feeding plan, treat, stock, and care log SwiftData facts.
caches.invalidation: Feeding command executors invalidate the narrow feeding snapshot touched by the command.
caches.expiry: Visible feeding route or home presenter lifetime; avoid broad recompute on unrelated taps.
caches.recovery: Keep previous snapshot stable during visible transitions and refresh in route-scoped work.

caches.invalidation: Only app release asset changes should alter bundled manifests.
caches.expiry: Static for the installed app build.
caches.recovery: Fallback to default avatar assets when a manifest entry or image is missing.
